## Appearance

Leslie Moore is described as an exceptionally lovely woman of striking good looks. She possesses sea-blue eyes and a splendid, shining head of gold hair that gleams like molten gold and falls to her feet in a fountain of living gold. Her arms gleam like ivory-tinted marble, contrasting with her slender, brown, work-hardened hands. She wears a plain dress made of cheap, cream-tinted cotton voile, finished with a crimson girdle.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014), +3 more_

## Personality

Leslie Moore is a clever, resolute woman who possesses a glowing, pent-up personality and a strong sense of duty. Though she is unhappy, a great change has come over her lately and she has been seen laughing and joking like a girl. She dislikes being pitied, is protective of taking her husband [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) around strangers, and once longed deeply to be a mother. A skilled dancer, she is also capable of exquisite embroidery and handwork. Looking to the future, she desires to make money to shingle her roof and intends to travel to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) in the fall to study nursing.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P6](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P10](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024), +7 more_

## History

Leslie Moore is the daughter of [Frank West](../character/frank-west.md) and Rose Elliott. She suffered early tragedy when her younger brother [Kenneth](../character/kenneth.md) died in a farm accident at age twelve, and two years later she discovered her father after he committed suicide. Raised by her mother, Leslie was coerced at age sixteen into marrying [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) to prevent mortgage foreclosure on her family home. She subsequently lost her mother to pneumonia, but later used money inherited from her grandmother to complete two years of study in one year at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and briefly teach at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) school. Living a bitter, troubled life caring for her invalid husband, Leslie forms a friendship with her neighbor [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) after meeting her on the shore. Though initially envious of Anne's happy marriage, Leslie reconciles with her, and later forms a close connection with visiting author [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md). She tearfully confesses her love for Owen to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after his departure, yet feels brokenhearted due to her marital situation. When [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reveals a potential surgical treatment for her husband, Leslie chooses to finance the operation in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal); there, it is discovered that the man was actually Dick's cousin George, and that [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) had died years prior. Free from her burden, Leslie returns home and is eventually reunited with Owen, who declares his love for her in the Blythes' garden. The couple gets engaged, with Owen planning to purchase [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's beloved house as a summer home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P4](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), +37 more_

## Quotes

> “I ENVY Anne,” said Leslie suddenly and fiercely, “and I’d envy her even if she had died! She was a mother for one beautiful day. I’d gladly give my life for THAT!”
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028)

> "If I had known I would have gone away—I wouldn’t have stayed here to meet him. You should have told me. It wasn’t fair of you, Anne—oh, it wasn’t fair!"
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P47](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0047)

> "Anne likes the pink ones best, and Gilbert likes the white. But I want the crimson ones. They satisfy some craving in me as no other flower does."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P5](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0005)

> "It seems too great to be real—I’m afraid to speak of it—to think of it. It seems to me that it must just be another dream of this house of dreams and it will vanish when I leave here."
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P29](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0029)

> "And, oh! I have such good news. He writes me that he is going to buy this place from the church trustees and keep it to spend our summer vacations in. Anne, are you not glad?"
>
> — Leslie Moore — [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--leslie-moore.md)

Leslie and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are neighbors and close companions who bond over shared walks along the shore and cozy evenings by the fire. Despite Leslie's reserved nature, bitter private tears, and initial lingering resentment toward Anne's happy circumstances, their friendship deepens as they share moments together, including Leslie gifting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a handcrafted dress for her baby.
